mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate from the prior month to the current month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined from t-2mo to t-1mo, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates labor market deterioration, which may reduce corporate profit growth and cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad-based demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST declined from t-2mo to t-1mo, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 110) indicates robust supply chain conditions and healthy corporate margins, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO > 110, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past two months signals strong household demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS increased from t-2mo to t-1mo, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, which may reduce consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declined and UNRATE rose from t-2mo to t-1mo, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized) signals a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.
